thread:
Alyssa (AE): heads up — Auriga Networks CISO pushed back on our POC. they require customer-managed keys in an HSM with written attestation before any test data. POC is blocked until we provide proof.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): thanks. can you paste the exact SQ clause? need to scope whether it's residency + HSM cert or also indemnity language.
Alyssa (AE): they sent: 

> "Vendor must prove integration with Customer HSM (FIPS 140-2 or higher) and guarantee keys never leave Customer control during testing. Written attestation required before any data transfer."

Nina (Security): this is stricter than our hosted default. two pragmatic options: 1) run a Private trial wired to their KMS and provide a demonstration attestation, or 2) use envelope keys with no key export but that may not satisfy 'attestation' language. both routes need legal review.
Tom (Platform): infra note — we can spin a Private demo in eu-west-1 and wire up their HSM over VPN/peering. ETA ~36 hours if infra prioritizes. will need a short test window for handshake.
Priya (Sales Lead): customer timeline is tight — they want written confirmation within 72 hours or they'll pull the on-site demo. we should escalate to execs.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a single-page CISO brief showing keyflow + network diagram. can attach sample KMS config (scrubbed) and the ops checklist.
Nina (Security): I'll draft a one-page attestation template and minimal redline language for Legal. avoid absolute guarantees; stick to facts we can demonstrate.
FinanceBot: heads-up: moving to Dedicated/Private changes pricing significantly. please include preliminary cost delta in the bridge invite.
Alyssa (AE): propose an exec bridge tomorrow 09:30 PT with their CISO, our Security lead, and Platform. Sara — sorry, Nina — can you join?
Nina (Security): yes I can. Tom (Platform) — can you be standby for infra Qs?
Tom (Platform): available. I'll prepare the deployment ETA, checklist, and required artifact list (HSM model + FIPS cert, temp test principal, egress IPs).
Ravi (Solutions Eng): sample KMS snippet I plan to show (sanitized):
```
kms_key {
  origin = "EXTERNAL_HSM"
  residency = "EU"
  usage = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
}
```
Alyssa (AE): action items: Alyssa schedule bridge + request artifacts; Nina draft attestation + redline; Tom prepare ETA + ops checklist; Ravi tech brief for CISO; Priya loop finance and execs.
Priya (Sales Lead): please copy finance on the invite as FYI — we may need a reserved capacity quote.
Alyssa (AE): will send invite now. I'll post the calendar link here when sent. if anything changes before bridge, update this thread. :thumbsup:
